hypotheses.C0_native_recomposition_is_exact: Recomposing the native attention write and exact bilinear MLP reproduces native logits with maximum error at most 1e-5 and effect fidelity at least 0.9999.
hypotheses.C1_upstream_address_survives_attention_d: Deleting final attention while recomputing the exact MLP retains selected-fact decoder-write fidelity at least 0.70 in every run.
hypotheses.C2_attention_is_needed_for_complete_rout: Deleting final attention yields complete-route fidelity below 0.70 on selected facts in every run.
hypotheses.C3_arbitrary_facts_need_attention_more_t: Attention deletion reduces complete-route fidelity at least 0.15 more for selected facts than unselected facts in every run.
hypotheses.C4_relation_mean_attention_is_sufficient: A discovery-frozen relation-mean attention write reaches selected complete-route fidelity at least 0.70 in every run.
hypotheses.C5_answer_oracle_attention_is_sufficient: A leaky relation+answer attention prototype reaches selected complete-route fidelity at least 0.80 in every run.
hypotheses.C6_site_specific_attention_matters: Shuffling attention writes across held-out facts reduces selected complete-route fidelity below 0.50 in every run.
hypotheses.C7_attention_is_a_small_norm_large_effec: Median attention-write norm is below 20% of incoming residual norm while deletion lowers selected complete-route fidelity by at least 0.20 in every run.
hypotheses.C8_causal_signal_gate_passes: Every status/run has at least 64 examples above the frozen Fisher-effect threshold.
